title: Concurrent 10-agent swarm: SON, NSB, RPI, EDC, X402, AIM

scope.objective: Execute six architecture amendments concurrently via 10 sub-agents with exclusive crate ownership and a central integration gate.
exclusions: PipeWire C binding (adapter when Wayland surface lands)

swarm.dispatch: single concurrent wave, exclusive crate ownership, no agent ran cargo (contention-free)

results.playbook: drive played 6/6, journal replay clean; disposition punt recorded

integration_fixes_by_coordinator: Mixer eviction semantics: test intended lower-numeric=more-urgent; implementation compared against lowest instead of highest active (J3)
Limiter mapped infinity to 0 instead of clamping to ceiling (J3)
Tap energy bound omitted the sample-rate factor (J3)
Bridge<T> move errors on non-Copy T (J4)
clamp_overshoot clamped the APPROACH side, snapping far states to the band edge — physics bug caught by the dt no-op test (J4)
Bridge::current() discarded the policy's bounded overshoot band (J4)
dt-splitting invariance test used dt values that were not FIXED_STEP multiples (J4)
settlement assert applied ! to an enum instead of assert_ne! (J9)
sonic rate-limiter burst test used 1 ms spacing where it claimed an instantaneous burst (J1)
spatial distance test asserted deep >= background, contradicting the inverse law it was verifying (J2)
test_evidence.notable_agent_finding: J10 found and fixed a real watermark security flaw: a naive key^position PRNG seed is GF(2)-linear under xorshift, making wrong-key keystream bits identical to the right key's — wrong keys detected payloads with full confidence. Fixed with nonlinear splitmix key mixing.

risk_assessment.determinism: spring solver is fixed-step and dt-split invariant at FIXED_STEP multiples; verified by test
risk_assessment.money: all amounts u128 exact integers; timeout never maps to Failed; idempotency blocks duplicate charges
risk_assessment.audio_callback: DSP path is allocation-free and pure per contract; real-time callback wiring arrives with the PipeWire adapter
risk_assessment.watermark: research prototype: robustness beyond ±2 pixel perturbation is unproven; no robustness claim is made without a corpus (per directive)
